I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread on her message. I couldn't confirm that Linnea Merriwether is the main contact for the Hollybank rollout at Marrow Agrisupply.

I checked #north-team and the shared files she can see, including the North cheat sheet. None of them mention Marrow Agrisupply, Hollybank or Linnea Merriwether. I told her it stays unconfirmed until someone on the account checks it.
